signature.name: VTask.dProd
signature.type: {ι : Type u_1} -> {α : Type u_2} -> {A : ι → Type u_3} -> [AddMonoid ι] -> [GradedMonoid.GMonoid A] -> (l : List α) -> (fι : α → ι) -> (fA : (a : α) → A (fι a)) -> A (l.dProdIndex fι)

conventions.note: NONE_DECLARED: VTask.dProd is a total function with no junk-value conventions; its behaviour on every input (including the empty list) is fully specified by the graded monoid axioms.

facts.statement: ∀ {ι : Type*} {α : Type*} [inst1 : AddMonoid ι] [inst2 : Monoid ℕ] (l : List α) (fι : α → ι) (fA : α → ℕ), @VTask.dProd ι α (fun _ : ι => ℕ) inst1 _ l fι fA = (l.map fA).prod
